title: THE TEAM LAMP STAYS IN FRONT OF THE GUN
why: Found by the overnight regression run. The small team lamp on the left shoulder strap (blue on you and your teammate, red on a pillager) hid under the held gun since the guns got bigger: facing east, south-east, south and west the gun covered it. It is drawn after the gun now, in the same place and size, so the side a body is on reads from the strap at every angle. Looks only.
now: The team lamp on the shoulder strap now shows in front of the gun at every angle.
